metadata.label: negative
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic kitchen scene showing a heavy cast-iron skillet resting on a wooden countertop. Visible heat haze shimmers in the air directly above the pan, but the wooden surface underneath the pan is covered in thick, jagged frost and ice crystals. Natural lighting, high detail, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: A hot pan emitting heat haze cannot simultaneously freeze the wooden surface it rests on, violating basic thermal conductivity.
